rows.text: At its meeting on 22 May 2006, the Monetary Council considered the latest economic and monetary developments and left the central bank base rate unchanged at 6.00%.

The Monetary Council discussed the May 2006 issue of the Bank’s
Quarterly Report on Inflation
. In relation to the
Report
, the Council is releasing its own press statement.
The minutes of today’s meeting will be published at 2 pm on 10 June 2006.
